tasks.label: Install Visual Studio C++ Build Tools
Build all release files to dist
Inspect Visual Studio install logs
args: Get-ChildItem "$env:TEMP\dd_*.log" | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 FullName,Length,LastWriteTime; Get-ChildItem "$env:TEMP\dd_*.log" | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 3 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "--- $($_.Name) ---"; Select-String -Path $_.FullName -Pattern 'error|failed|cancel|exit|completed|download|package' | Select-Object -Last 12 }

tasks.label: List Visual Studio logs
args: Get-ChildItem $env:TEMP -Filter dd_*.log | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Name,FullName,Length,LastWriteTime

tasks.label: Find Visual Studio install errors
args: Get-ChildItem $env:TEMP -Filter dd_setup_*.log | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 30 | Select-String -Pattern error,failed,exception,rollback | Select-Object -First 30

tasks.label: Verify MSVC compiler
args: $cl='C:\BuildTools\VS2022\VC\Tools\MSVC\14.44.35207\bin\Hostx64\x64\cl.exe'; Write-Output "cl_exists=$(Test-Path $cl)"; & 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe' -all -products '*' -property installationPath; Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.ProcessName -match 'vs_installer|setup|vs_BuildTools|vs_setup_bootstrapper'} | Select-Object ProcessName,Id,CPU
